prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1262; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Katy, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt a sharp pain in my right shoulder almost immediately. I stopped at the scene, exchanged information with the other driver, and waited for the police to arrive. Since then I have remembered a few more small details, such as the exact position of the traffic light, but the core of what happened has not changed. I am the policyholder named on this policy, and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed. I have been seeing a doctor about my shoulder and will provide records as they become available.
